panelNote: It is your turn to sign off "{{name}}". Control points are read-only; review them, then approve or return the assessment to an earlier step.
approveLastNote: This is the last step: approving closes the assessment and locks it for everyone.
returnNote: Sign-offs from the target step onwards are voided (they stay in the sign-off history), and signing restarts from that step; returning to one unit leaves what the other units finished in place.
returnToRequired: Choose the step to return to
approvedBranch: Approved; this unit moved on to "{{name}}"
approvedWaiting: Approved; the assessment moves on once every other unit is done

errors.forbidden: It is no longer your step, or the assessment is closed; reload the page
errors.self_check_step: Self-check steps sign off by submitting their answers
errors.invalid_target: This step cannot return to that one; reload the page

history.title: Sign-off history
history.note: Sign-offs are recorded by the system: account, name, time and sign-off number. Voided sign-offs were cancelled by a later return and stay in the history.
